_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: On a phone, three separated edits in hunks.txt are three navigation stops. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. Open Diffs: on a phone it is in the overflow menu: click the button named "More options", then, in its popover (".chat-overflow-popover"), the button whose accessible name starts with "Diffs" (".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label=\"Diffs\"]"). The ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. Click ".diff-viewer-overlay .commit-picker-trigger"; in ".git-graph-container" click the ".git-graph-row" containing "Working changes". In ".diff-rethink-mobile-files", the row with title "hunks.txt" has its added and deleted counts on the same horizontal line: their bounding-box y values differ by less than 2 pixels (eval with expect true). Click that row. ".diff-rethink-file-name" should read "hunks.txt" and ".diff-rethink-file-position" should contain "File 1 of 1". The bottom ".diff-rethink-bottom-change-label" should read "Change 1 of 3"; the button "Previous hunk (,)" must not exist. Click "Next hunk (.)": label is "Change 2 of 3". Click it again: label is "Change 3 of 3" and the button "Next hunk (.)" must not exist. Click "Previous hunk (,)": label is "Change 2 of 3".

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.diff-rethink-mobile-files [title="hunks.txt"]'); if (!rows.length) return 'no row found'; const row = rows[0].closest('[class]'); const added = row.querySelector('.diff-added-count') || row.querySelector('[class*="added"]'); const deleted = row.querySelector('.diff-deleted-count') || row.querySelector('[class*="deleted"]'); if (!added || !deleted) return 'counts not found: ' + row.innerHTML.substring(0, 200); const ar = added.getBoundingClientRect(); const dr = deleted.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs(ar.y - dr.y) < 2; })()
